security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Rewrites a document into plain language and gives you a LinkedIn version.
bundle.longDescription: Opens a Word, PDF, Markdown or text file, rewrites it into plainer language, removes invisible characters, applies your own rules, and gives you a Word document plus a LinkedIn post you can copy. Everything runs on your machine. No account, no server, no AI model, nothing leaves the computer.
